content: Twenty years I poured steel. Then suits shipped my mill overseas. I'm Jackson Alvarez — and I'm taking Valoria back for the working class!
Valoria's deficit is a ticking bomb. I spent my career defusing monetary crises. Now I'll balance the ledger itself. Fiscal discipline. Sustainable growth.
I held the Northern Border when others flinched. I secured Valoria once. Now, one final call: command. Strength at the Border. Peace Through Power.
I built billions from nothing. Valoria's the biggest acquisition of my career — and every citizen becomes a shareholder tonight. Let's get rich.
I grew up watching Daddy buy senators over dessert. I walked away from the fortune—now I'm spending it breaking the empire that raised me.
Valoria's soul is sick. For thirty years I have healed souls—now I answer a higher calling: heal this fractured land. Elijah Haddon.
I brought eighty hostages home without firing a single shot. Now Valoria itself needs negotiating for. I read rooms. I read threats. I never miss.
Your republic runs on legacy code. I built the neural lace—now I'll recompile civilization itself. Vivienne Zhao. The upgrade begins tonight.
Thirty-five years steadying this Republic through every storm. Others promise experiments; I offer proven hands. Valoria deserves tested leadership—not on-the-job training.
Four governors convicted. Two oligarchs imprisoned. Three car bombs survived. Prosecutor Garrick Stone—entering the arena, because no oligarch is above the law.
